messages:
toni (Design): quick check on the Encryption -> Region picker mock. goal: make it clear which regions use Redwood-managed keys vs customer KMS (BYOK). attached mock. looking for accessibility, copy, and keyboard behavior feedback.

mohit (Product): nice start. two asks: 1) default to account region but allow override. 2) expand BYOK inline to 'bring your own key' once in helper copy.

kevin (Eng): implementation notes: we’ll use a custom combobox on modern browsers, fallback to native select otherwise. follow combobox pattern: aria-activedescendant on options, and aria-describedby referencing helper text. don’t embed helper inside listbox. add a polite aria-live status for selection changes.

samir (Security): prefer explicit labels: "Redwood-managed key (AES-256)" and "Customer-managed KMS (BYOK)". change any UI "key id" -> "key reference". helper text should state audit logs will record region + key reference when BYOK is used.

allegra (PM): UX: if tenant hasn’t uploaded a key, show BYOK option disabled with tooltip: "Requires uploaded key and IAM role — see docs." keep the option visible but explain prerequisites.

toni (Design): updated plan: show compact badges with icon + text (not color-only), helper row under control: "Audit logs record region and key reference when customer-managed keys are used." wire helper via aria-describedby; include small "learn more" link.

mohit (Product): when switching to BYOK, show confirmation modal: title "Switch to customer-managed KMS (BYOK)", body "New requests will use this key. Audit logs will record the key reference. You must upload or grant access to the key." include propagation note: "Changes may take up to 2 minutes to propagate."

kevin (Eng): aria-live example (polite): "Region set to eu-west-1. Using customer-managed key; audit logs will record key reference." tests should assert aria-describedby exists and aria-live updates.

a11y-bot: quick checklist: combobox role, aria-activedescendant updates, aria-describedby present, focus outline visible, badge contrast >= 4.5:1. manual review flagged.

samir (Security): I'll add CI audit tests: enable BYOK, change region, verify audit entry includes region + key_reference; verify disabled BYOK doesn't emit key_reference.

toni (Design): thanks — punchlist: badge labels, helper text (aria-describedby), disabled BYOK tooltip, modal copy + propagation note, aria-live announcement. will push updated mock and a11y checklist to the ticket later today.
